name: popsicle
headline: AI-Content-Image-Generator: SaaS platform with chat
short_description: AI-powered content and image generation SaaS platform built with Laravel, featuring a chat interface with AI. This project enables users to interact with AI for content creation, image generation, and real-time conversations, providing a creative and marketing experience. Open-source and customizable.
author: qtecsolution

sections.overview:
This Laravel-based SaaS platform provides AI-powered tools for content generation, image creation, code writing, and intelligent chatbot interactions. It includes dynamic use case templates tailored for various industries, enabling users to generate specialized content quickly. The platform integrates multiple payment gateways—Stripe, Razorpay, Amar Pay, and bank transfer—to support global and local transactions. Additional features include real-time customer support via Tawk.to chat integration and Progressive Web App (PWA) functionality for fast, responsive access across devices. It's designed for marketing teams, developers, content creators, and businesses seeking a customizable, open-source solution for AI-driven content and code generation.
Generate blog posts and marketing copy with AI content generator
Create unique AI-generated images for marketing campaigns
Write and debug code across multiple programming languages with AI assistance
Deploy industry-specific content templates for faster production
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/qtecsolution/AI-Content-Image-Generator-SaaS`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a [CONTENT_TYPE] for [TARGET_AUDIENCE] that highlights the benefits of [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Use a [TONE] tone and include [KEY_MESSAGE]. Include a compelling headline and 2-3 bullet points for clarity. Suggest 3 relevant hashtags for social media distribution.
```
Copy

```
Headline: 'Unlock Your Team's Potential with AI-Powered Content Creation'

Content:
In today's fast-paced marketing landscape, creating high-quality content consistently is a challenge. Our AI-powered content generation platform helps marketing teams like yours scale content production without sacrificing quality. Whether you need blog posts, social media captions, or email newsletters, our platform delivers tailored content in minutes.

Key Benefits:
• Save 10+ hours per week on content creation
• Maintain brand voice consistency across all channels
• Generate SEO-optimized content with built-in keyword suggestions

Hashtags: #ContentCreation #MarketingAutomation #AITools

Example Output Length: 150 words
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
